description: Lets the frontend subscribe to backend events. Commands defined by this app need no permission; the core event plugin does, and without this the webview's listen() is rejected — so transcripts, levels and session state never arrive. Deliberately narrow: only what is actually used, so a future need fails loudly rather than being silently pre-granted. The detached group windows (P7) are the same frontend on the same events, so they are named by the glob their labels are built from — see GROUP_WINDOW_PREFIX; a window that is not covered here comes up blank and silent, which is why the pattern has to follow that constant. The tickers (P24) are the same again, under TICKER_WINDOW_PREFIX, and so is the shoutbox window (P26), under SHOUTBOX_WINDOW.
